commands.skyabyss_play.help.0: §bAdmin commands (/skyabyss admin) §7- permission level from the server config adminPermissionLevel (default 2 = operator). [targets] takes several players (@a, a party); default yourself. Targets go after the arguments (before optional ones)
commands.skyabyss_play.help.1: §e# Chapter/places §fadmin chapter <0-5> [targets] [stage] §7- set up a chapter (0 fresh/1 whale/2 tide/3 storm/4 ember/5 abyss). Give targets to give a stage
commands.skyabyss_play.help.2: §fadmin goto <place> [targets] §7- teleport (overworld, whale.., <titan>-<spot>, abyss, abyss-<mark>, abyss-depth-<n>)
commands.skyabyss_play.help.3: §fadmin skip opening [targets] §7- skip the prologue  §fadmin now [targets] §7- trigger the next event of the current objective
commands.skyabyss_play.help.4: §e# Boss/raid §fadmin boss <whale|tide|storm|ember|raiju|smith|warden|nightmare> [targets] [tier 0-4] §7- go to the boss
commands.skyabyss_play.help.5: §fadmin raid <titan> <room> [targets] §7- carry the party into a route room (1-3 / walk, wit, fight / room id); the main quest stage follows
commands.skyabyss_play.help.6: §fadmin trials <titan> [targets] §7- clear every trial on that back
commands.skyabyss_play.help.7: §e# Quests §fadmin quest list [targets] §7- active quests (main and sub)
commands.skyabyss_play.help.8: §fadmin quest next [targets] [id] §7- advance to the next stage (no id = tracked, then the active main). Rewards, journal, strip and NPC topics update as for real
commands.skyabyss_play.help.9: §fadmin quest set <id> <stage> [targets] §7, §fadmin quest done <id> [targets] §7, §fadmin quest reset <id> [targets]
commands.skyabyss_play.help.10: §e# Kit/state §fadmin kit <iron|whale|tide|storm|ember> [targets] §7- gear set  §fadmin status [targets] §7- chapter, quests, stilled titans
commands.skyabyss_play.help.11: §fadmin heal|feed [targets] §7, §fadmin god on|off [targets] §7, §fadmin reset [targets] §7- heal, feed, invulnerable, back to a fresh state
commands.skyabyss_play.help.12: §fadmin lore unlock-all|reset [targets] §7- unlock all lore / wipe it
commands.skyabyss_play.help.13: §e# World §fadmin time day|noon|night|midnight §7, §fadmin day <n> §7, §fadmin fast on|off §7, §fadmin weather clear|rain|thunder §7, §fadmin peaceful on|off
commands.skyabyss_play.help.14: §e# Players §fadmin inspect <player> §7- view their record (J) · §fadmin level <1-50> [targets] §7· §fadmin coins <amount> [targets] §7- set level, give bell coins
commands.skyabyss_play.help.15: §7Example: two players to the 2nd whale room -> /skyabyss admin raid whale 2 @a  /  advance everyone's quest -> /skyabyss admin quest next @a

commands.skyabyss_play.help.16: §e■ Sealed boxes §fadmin box give <kind> [n] §7— get boxes · §fadmin box open §7— open the box opener screen here
commands.skyabyss_play.help.17: §fadmin version §7- mod version and the data version of this world and yourself (checks the upgrade after an update)
